gaps.sentence: Never again ___ they offer credit to first-time customers.
gaps.explanation: 'Never again would they offer' — inverted modal for a past decision.

gaps.sentence: So convinced ___ he of his innocence that he refused the deal.
gaps.explanation: 'So convinced was he of …' — inversion after fronted 'so + adj'.

gaps.sentence: Hardly had we started ___ the engine failed.
gaps.explanation: Hardly … when — fixed pair: Hardly had we started when…

gaps.sentence: At no point ___ the pilot leave the cockpit.
gaps.explanation: At no point did… = never did… — negative adverbial inversion.

gaps.sentence: Little ___ they know that the deal had already collapsed.
gaps.explanation: Little did they know = they had no idea — emphatic idiom with inversion.

gaps.sentence: Not only ___ the play cancelled, but the theatre was closed as well.
gaps.explanation: 'Not only was the play cancelled' — inverted passive.

gaps.sentence: Not since the winter of 1963 ___ temperatures dropped so low.
gaps.explanation: 'Not since 1963 have temperatures dropped …' — the only time from then until now.

gaps.sentence: ___ it not been for the lifeguard, the boy would have drowned.
gaps.explanation: 'Had it not been for …' = 'If it had not been for …'.
